tips.title: Pay with Alipay or WeChat Pay
tips.text: Link your Visa or Mastercard in Alipay and WeChat Pay before you fly. Alipay is free up to ¥200 and charges 3% above that. Carry some cash for street taxis and small shops.

tips.title: Get a taxi through Alipay
tips.text: In Alipay, tap Transport, then Taxi; it books DiDi with your linked card. Show the driver the hotel name in Chinese: 川行隐里酒店(成都宽窄巷子店), 十二桥路19号.

tips.title: Ride the metro with a QR code
tips.text: In Alipay, open Transport, then Metro, and scan the QR code at the gates; fares are ¥2–8, trains 6:00–23:00. The hotel's station is 通惠门 on Line 2, which runs straight to 春熙路.

tips.title: Order hotpot the local way
tips.text: Ask for a 鸳鸯锅 (split pot) and say 微辣 for mild. Use the communal chopsticks for raw food. About ¥80–150 per person.

tips.title: Set up your apps before you fly
tips.text: Google, WhatsApp, Instagram and YouTube are blocked in China; LINE needs a roaming plan or a travel eSIM. Install Alipay, WeChat, Amap and Baidu Translate at home.

tips.title: Pack layers for mid-November
tips.text: About 15–20°C by day and 9–14°C morning and evening, often grey with drizzle. Bring a sweater, a windproof jacket and a small umbrella.

tips.title: Claim your tax refund
tips.text: Spend at least ¥200 in one store on the same day, such as Chengdu IFS, and ask for the VAT refund form.

tips.title: Emergency numbers
tips.text: Police 110, ambulance 120, fire 119, traffic accident 122. Royal Thai Consulate-General in Chengdu: +86 28 6689 7861; emergency line for Thai nationals +86 157 0842 8656.
